```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(arules)
library(arulesViz)
```

## Task 1: Compute support, confidence, and lift by hand

```{r task1-toy-data}
trans_list <- list(
  T1 = c("dental", "vision"),
  T2 = c("dental", "mental"),
  T3 = c("dental", "vision", "mental"),
  T4 = c("vision", "mental"),
  T5 = c("dental", "vision")
)
N <- length(trans_list)

contains <- function(trans_list, itemset) {
  sum(sapply(trans_list, function(t) all(itemset %in% t)))
}
```

```{r task1-support}
supp_dental        <- contains(trans_list, "dental") / N
supp_vision        <- contains(trans_list, "vision") / N
supp_mental        <- contains(trans_list, "mental") / N
supp_dental_vision <- contains(trans_list, c("dental", "vision")) / N

cat("supp({dental})        =", supp_dental, "\n")        # 0.80
cat("supp({vision})        =", supp_vision, "\n")        # 0.80
cat("supp({mental})        =", supp_mental, "\n")        # 0.60
cat("supp({dental, vision})=", supp_dental_vision, "\n") # 0.60
```

```{r task1-confidence}
conf_d_v <- supp_dental_vision / supp_dental
conf_v_d <- supp_dental_vision / supp_vision

cat("conf(dental → vision) =", conf_d_v, "\n")  # 0.75
cat("conf(vision → dental) =", conf_v_d, "\n")  # 0.75
```

```{r task1-lift}
lift_d_v <- conf_d_v / supp_vision

cat("lift(dental → vision) =", lift_d_v, "\n")  # 0.9375
# Lift < 1: slight negative association. A policyholder with dental cover is
# marginally LESS likely than average to also have vision cover. With only 5
# transactions this is not statistically meaningful, but the calculation is correct.
```

## Task 2: Verify the anti-monotone property

```{r task2-antimonotone}
min_supp <- 0.60

supp_dental_mental <- contains(trans_list, c("dental", "mental")) / N
cat("supp({dental, mental}) =", supp_dental_mental, "— infrequent:", supp_dental_mental < min_supp, "\n")
# supp = 0.40 < 0.60 → infrequent

supp_all_three <- contains(trans_list, c("dental", "vision", "mental")) / N
cat("supp({dental, vision, mental}) =", supp_all_three, "— also infrequent:", supp_all_three < min_supp, "\n")
# supp = 0.20 < 0.60 → also infrequent ✓

# The anti-monotone property holds: supp({dental,mental}) = 0.40 < 0.60
# implies supp({dental,vision,mental}) ≤ 0.40 < 0.60.
# In fact supp({dental,vision,mental}) = 0.20, which is even lower, as expected.
```

## Task 3: Run apriori() on the toy transactions

```{r task3-apriori}
trans <- as(trans_list, "transactions")
inspect(trans)

rules <- apriori(
  trans,
  parameter = list(supp = 0.40, conf = 0.60, minlen = 2)
)

inspect(sort(rules, by = "lift"))
```

## Task 4: Interpret the top rules

```{r task4-interpret}
top_rules <- head(sort(rules, by = "lift"), 3)
inspect(top_rules)

# Rule 1: {mental} → {vision}  (check actual output for values)
# Business interpretation: Policyholders who hold mental health cover also tend
# to hold vision cover. The insurer could bundle these two add-ons and offer a
# small discount to increase uptake of both.

# Rule 2: {vision} → {dental}
# Business interpretation: Vision cover holders are also likely to have dental.
# A cross-sell campaign targeting vision policyholders with dental cover offers
# is statistically justified.

# Rule 3: {dental, vision} → {mental}  (if it appears)
# Business interpretation: Customers who have both dental and vision cover show
# elevated interest in mental health cover — a natural candidate for the
# platinum plan or a comprehensive bundle offer.
```
